rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the practice of collecting and sorting waste for reuse.

example.english: Recycling should start at home: plastic bottles and cardboard need to be separated.
example.traditional: 回收要由屋企開始，膠樽同紙皮要分開。
example.jyutping: wui4 sau1 jiu3 jau4 uk1 kei2 hoi1 ci2 gaau1 zeon1 tung4 zi2 pei4 jiu3 fan1 hoi1

rows.note: Use this for the recyclable materials themselves, especially when talking about taking them somewhere for collection.

example.english: I took a bag of recycling materials to the collection point downstairs.
example.traditional: 我拎咗一袋回收物去樓下個回收站。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ling1 zo2 jat1 doi6 wui4 sau1 mat6 heoi3 lau4 haa6 go3 wui4 sau1 zaam6

rows.note: Use this for a product made from recycled material rather than for the recycling process or the waste collected.

example.english: These products are made through recycling waste materials.
example.traditional: 呢批再造品由回收物料製成。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 zoi3 zou6 ban2 jau4 wui4 sau1 mat6 liu6 zai3 sing4
